name: PagerDuty API
tagline: REST API for incidents, services, schedules, and on-call automation
description: PagerDuty provides a REST API for managing incidents, services, escalation policies, schedules, and users. Developers use it to open and resolve incidents, query on-call rotations, automate response workflows, and integrate alerting into custom tooling and CI/CD systems.

auth.details: API key or OAuth 2.0 access token via Authorization: Token token=YOUR_API_KEY (or Bearer for OAuth). From-Token header often required for user context.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free plan available for small teams; API rate limits apply separately (see rate_limits). Exact free API request quotas not clearly published as a simple daily cap.
pricing.paid_plans: Professional, Business, and Enterprise plans with per-user pricing; details on pagerduty.com/pricing

rate_limits: Typically 900 requests per minute for most REST endpoints; some write endpoints lower. Exact limits may vary by account/plan.
use_cases: list open incidents for a service
create an incident from a monitoring alert
get who is currently on-call for a schedule
acknowledge or resolve an incident by ID
add a note to an incident during triage
